item.title: Alessia Cara Reinvents Her Catalog On New Album 'Love Or Lack Thereof'
item.description: Alessia Cara reinvents her catalog on new album 'Love Or Lack Thereof,' which presents remakes of songs from throughout her career.

item.title: Cruz Beckham Announces First North American Headline Tour
item.description: Rising rock star Cruz Beckham will embark on a first North American headline tour this summer, following a sold-out run across Europe.

item.title: Coco Jones Releases Video For New Single 'LUVAGIRL'
item.description: After a banner year, R&amp;B star Coco Jones has released a video for 'LUVAGIRL,' her first new studio recording of 2026.

item.title: Tori Amos Releases New Single 'Shush'
item.description: Tori Amos has released new single 'Shush,' the latest from the singer-songwriter’s anticipated new concept album 'In Times of Dragons.'

item.title: The Beach Boys Celebrate 60 Years of ‘Pet Sounds’
item.description: The Beach Boys are celebrating the 60th anniversary of their album ‘Pet Sounds’ by releasing it in several new vinyl formats.

item.title: Designs For Life: Celebrating The Art Of Punk
item.description: Since 1977, punk has been the catalyst for an infinite number of radical art and fashion statements which continue to influence the world.

item.title: ‘Rumor And Sigh’: The Word About Richard Thompson Gets Ever Louder
item.description: 'Rumor And Sigh' was the sixth solo album from Fairport Convention co-founder Richard Thompson, one of Britain’s most admired songwriters.

item.title: Best Jazz Albums: Essential Albums You Need To Hear
item.description: Including career-defining sessions that continue to endure, the best jazz albums of all time offer a wealth of stunning, must-hear music.

item.title: Sting Shares New Remixes On ‘Desert Rose Reimagined’ EP
item.description: Sting has shared the new remix EP ‘Desert Rose Reimagined,’ which features three new remixes from Bedouin, Zakes Bantwini, and Darque.

item.title: t.A.T.u.’s 'All The Things She Said' Arrives On Vinyl
item.description: t.A.T.u.’s 'All The Things She Said' arrives on 12-inch picture vinyl after featuring in HBO’s hit show ‘Heated Rivalry.’

item.title: Feist’s 'My Moon My Man' Reissued On 7-Inch Vinyl
item.description: Feist shares a new limited-edition reissue of 'My Moon My Man' after a resurgence in popularity thanks to the HBO series ‘Heated Rivalry.’

item.title: ‘Elton John - The Remixes’ Album Arriving For Record Store Day
item.description: ‘Elton John - The Remixes’ has been announced as a Record Store Day 2026 release. It'll arrive at participating stores on April 18.

item.title: Ne-Yo’s ‘Miss Independent’ Joins Spotify’s Billions Club
item.description: Ne-Yo’s hit 'Miss Independent' has joined the Spotify Billions Club, nearly 20 years after its initial release.

item.title: Olivia Rodrigo Announces New Album, ‘You Seem Pretty Sad For A Girl So In Love’
item.description: Olivia Rodrigo has announced her third album, ‘you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love,’ will be out on June 12th.

item.title: Yeat Shares ‘Naked’ Video, Starring Ice Spice
item.description: Rapper Yeat has shared the video for his track ‘Naked’ starring Ice Spice. The song comes from his new double album ‘ADL.’
